latestVersion.changelog:
Editor Edimakor 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Launches AI-powered editing of raw video clips (MP4, MOV, AVI, MKV up to 500MB) into polished, exportable 1080p MP4 videos.
- Supports video trimming, adding transitions, text overlays, audio tracks, and background music.
- Automatic backend token creation and session setup on first use; 100 free credits for new users.
- Real-time status updates and clear communication for uploads, editing, and exports.
- Built-in handling for common errors (file format/size, token/session, credits, export limits).
- Exports high-quality 1080p MP4 files within 1–2 minutes using cloud GPUs.
